newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt airport cargo up 7.9pct in March '97.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt airport cargo up 7.9pct in March '97.

text.p: Total air cargo flown to and from Frankfurt airport in March rose strongly by 7.9 percent year-on-year to 130,270 tonnes, airport authority figures showed.
The positive growth in air cargo seen in recent months picked up in March despite the early Easter which reduced production times, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) traffic report said.
Both exports and imports were now growing equally strongly while improved load factors in larger freighters had led to a 10 percent rise in freighter tonnage, it added.
